sources.text: Forward-only synthetic E=4, top-k=2 gated MoE subgraph, with EP=2 and TP=1 or 2; all experts remain resident. Every global token routes to one expert in each owner. The balanced profile touches both experts per owner; the concentrated profile touches one, with the same number of token assignments. Route packets carry BF16 activations, int64 expert indices and FP32 probabilities: 2H+12 bytes per assignment. Token order is known from the declared fixed routing map. One TP×EP dispatch and two separate owner combine collectives are declared; these are not a claim to reproduce a fused production dispatcher. Owner preparation/unpacking and repacking use distinct buffers with explicit HBM traffic. Transport workspace=0 is an ideal-buffer assumption; communication local HBM and reduction arithmetic remain unknown. Artificial matrix/vector ceilings 1000 operations/s, HBM 100 byte/s, network 1000 byte/s, per-round latency 0.001 seconds, and 4096-byte devices are arithmetic references only.
Routing balanced: token order and expert choices are author declarations, not inferred from FLOPs or executed router scores. Vector proxies: top-k 3TE, SiLU+product 5RI, weighted combine 3TH.

formula.description: Explicit analytical equation. Multiply-add counts as two operations; no executable model code.
